section_summary.extract_value: This section (2.2.4) describes the measurement of body pride using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES), a 6-item instrument rated on a 5-point scale. The text reports that the BASES has good factorial validity, test-retest reliability, and construct validity, with an ordinal coefficient of .97 for the Authentic Pride subscale in the present study. This is a methods/instruments description section and does not contain study-level demographic or outcome data.
